result:
This is correct and complete. All the fixes are in place, type-checking passes, and all 617 existing tests still pass. Here's a summary of the root causes found and fixed:

**Root cause**: archiving a membership only sets `archivedAt`; `status` is deliberately left as `"active"` as a historical record. Many call sites checked `member.status !== "active"` without also checking `archivedAt`, so a removed member still looked "active" everywhere.

- **Security (#1)** — `session-service.ts` (`resolveActorForOrg`, `switchActiveOrg`) and `member-service.ts` (`resolveActor`) now use a new `memberRepo.findActiveMember` helper that checks both status and `archivedAt`, so a removed member can no longer resolve an `Actor` (blocking every action, including posting comments) or switch into the workspace.
- **Support (#2)** — `invitation-service.ts#acceptInvitation` no longer short-circuits on any existing row; it now distinguishes a live member (invitation consumed, nothing else changes) from a former member (reactivated on the same row via new `memberRepo.reactivateMember`, with fresh role/inviter/join date, re-emitting `member.joined`).
- **Notifications (#3)** — `notification-service.ts#notify` now skips recipients who aren't current active members; `digest-service.ts#listDigestRecipients` filters digest subscribers the same way.
- **Project management (#4)** — `issue-service.ts` and `project-service.ts` now reject assigning issues / setting a project lead to anyone who isn't a current active member; `member-service.ts#removeMember` cascades via new repo functions `issueRepo.unassignIssuesForUser` and `projectRepo.clearLeadForUser`.
- **Admin (#5)** — `member-service.ts#updateMemberRole` and `removeMember` now call `assertNotArchived`, turning a repeat role-change or repeat removal into an `AlreadyArchivedError` (409 conflict), preventing duplicate `member.removed` events that were double-decrementing the seat count.
